name: ATT&CK Framework Blind Spots - No NIST 800-53 Coverage
description: The 231 live ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 techniques with NO mapped NIST 800-53 R5 control (CTID), under their own id or a revoked predecessor's. These are framework blind spots that cannot be addressed by control coverage alone and require compensating detection, architecture, or process controls. Score = threat groups using the technique + 1, so darker = used by more groups (higher priority) and every blind spot is shaded. The CTID mapping targets ATT&CK v16.1, so techniques added since then that do not succeed a mapped id have no mapping by construction. Source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 + CTID NIST 800-53 R5 mappings. Generated by scripts/build_priority_gaps.py.
